weeklyDigest.subject: Your week on AutoMe — {dealership}
weeklyDigest.heading: Your week at {dealership}
weeklyDigest.footer: You get this summary every Saturday. You can turn it off or change its language in Settings → Weekly summary.

renewalDue.subject: Your {plan} plan renews on {date}
renewalDue.heading: Time to renew {plan}
renewalDue.body: {dealership} is on {plan} until {date}. Pay {amount} for the next {period, select, YEARLY {year} other {month}} to keep it without a break.

renewalReminder.subject: A few days left on {plan}: renew by {date}
renewalReminder.heading: A few days left on {plan}
renewalReminder.body: {dealership}’s {plan} plan ends on {date}. Pay {amount} for the next {period, select, YEARLY {year} other {month}} before then to keep it.

trialDue.subject: Your {plan} trial ends on {date}
trialDue.heading: Your trial is ending
trialDue.body: {dealership}’s free {plan} trial ends on {date}. Pay {amount} for a {period, select, YEARLY {year} other {month}} to keep {plan} after it.

trialReminder.subject: A few days left in your {plan} trial
trialReminder.heading: A few days left in your trial
trialReminder.body: {dealership}’s free {plan} trial ends on {date}. Pay {amount} for a {period, select, YEARLY {year} other {month}} to keep {plan}; otherwise you move to the free Starter plan.

pastDue.subject: Payment overdue for {plan}
pastDue.heading: We haven’t received your payment
pastDue.body: {dealership}’s {plan} plan wasn’t renewed. Pay by {date} to keep it; after that your dealership moves to the free Starter plan.

downgradedCanceled.subject: {dealership} is now on the free Starter plan
downgradedCanceled.heading: Your {plan} plan has ended
downgradedCanceled.body: As you asked, {plan} has ended and {dealership} is now on the free Starter plan. Its limits apply from today. You can choose a plan again at any time.

downgradedUnpaid.subject: {dealership} is now on the free Starter plan
downgradedUnpaid.heading: Your dealership is on the free Starter plan
downgradedUnpaid.body: We didn’t receive the payment for {plan}, so {dealership} has moved to the free Starter plan. Its limits apply from today. Pay for a plan at any time to get everything back.

paymentReceived.subject: Payment received: {amount}
paymentReceived.heading: Thank you for your payment
paymentReceived.body: We received {amount} for {plan}. {dealership} is paid until {date}.
paymentReceived.bodyAhead: We received {amount} for {plan}. {dealership}’s next period starts on {start} and is paid until {date}.

paymentFailed.subject: Your payment didn’t go through
paymentFailed.heading: Your payment didn’t go through
paymentFailed.body: Your payment of {amount} for {plan} wasn’t completed, and nothing was charged. You can try again from your billing page.

billing.footer: You get this email because you own {dealership} on AutoMe.
